Jordan: Quick sketch 20 split surfaces for multi-region: control-plane leases, inference data-plane, compliance/audit fanout. Diagram: https://redwood/internal/multisite/failure_map.png
Maya: Do you want a proto + runbook strawman?
Jordan: Yes. Lease proto idea: LeaseAcquire(tenant_id, preferred_site, ttl) -> LeaseToken(site, expires_at). Idempotency required.
Liam: Default to active/active with primary-affinity hints? Or support active/passive opt-in?
Jordan: Default active/active + client header hints. Tenant-level "local-only" to pin writes; active/passive only by opt-in.
Sara: Residency must block raw logs/telemetry leaving region. Use selective fanout for audits.
Nina: Traces need site tag, residency flag, and cross-site span id. Metric: cross_site_failover{tenant,from,to,reason}.
Ethan: Operator note: overload circuit should return 429+residency-route for residency tenants, allow failover for others. Add preflight check: no migrations in last 15m before experiments.
Liam: Cache warming: async pre-warm prefixes on steady-state shifts. For residency tenants, only mirror metadata/consent stamps.
Jordan: Tests: chaos (site kill), burst (cross-site surge), compliance sim (EU tenant). Include conflict policy appendix: inference=idem, metadata=CRDT, billing=append-only.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary started infra-canary-3 branch multisite/failure-surface at 2026-03-23T12:05Z :rocket:
Jordan: I'll draft RFC with proto, runbook, test matrix, and owners. Schedule 30m sync after PR.
